## Contract surface

Describe which WIT, Protobuf, JSON Schema, Rust trait, or SDK interfaces change.

## Compatibility

State whether the change is additive, source-compatible, wire-compatible, or breaking.

## Resource model

Explain whether the change can alter idle resource usage, activation budgets, cache bounds, or provider pooling.

## Security

Document capability, identity, trust-boundary, and supply-chain effects.

## Decision record

Link the relevant ADR or RFC.

## Verification

List conformance tests, schema checks, benchmarks, or review evidence.

- [ ] I reviewed the final commits and diff against the target branch, reconciled
  already delivered parent commits, and checked that authorship and validation
  claims describe the exact source, following
  [Commit history and evidence](../CONTRIBUTING.md#commit-history-and-evidence).
